bio.text: Rick Brattin, a Republican, was elected in 2020 to represent Missouri's 31st Senatorial District in the Missouri Senate.
He previously served four terms in the Missouri House of Representatives from 2010 to 2018 and was auditor of Cass County.
He served six years in the U.S. Marines, reaching the rank of sergeant, and founded a small construction business.
He won the Republican primary on August 4, 2026 for Missouri's 5th Congressional District.

sources.title: Rick Brattin wins Missouri 5th District GOP primary amid uncertainty over district lines
